description: Who this key is: plan (free/creator/studio/agency), requests per hour, whether it can publish, today's daily content-query quota (free plan: 24 shared across trending, search, best-time, hashtags, sounds, communities, calendar, quotes; templates, board context and news categories spend none), credits balance, and per-endpoint rules. Call it once at the start and again on a 429 or 402, and set expectations from it (free plan: trending is 72h delayed and numbers are withheld, never print 0). On the Free plan connecting accounts, publishing, scheduling and Review are not available, so never propose them as the next step; free_drafts {limit, used, remaining, resets_at} says how many of the 10 drafts a month (saved with no account) are left. Run the free path (the niche from viralhunt_board_context, ONE well-filtered viralhunt_trending call with the 3 best posts and why, the best one on a template with viralhunt_get_template preview true, saved as a free draft with viralhunt_schedule draft true and its design, then once the paid plans: https://viralhunt.io/pricing?utm_source=mcp-server&utm_medium=ai-assistant&utm_campaign=upgrade).
name: viralhunt_account
